title: Walnut Wrap with Feta and Olives
description: A delicious and healthy Mediterranean-inspired snack or light meal. The combination of crumbled feta, juicy olives, and crunchy walnuts is elevated by the tangy wrap.
instructions: 1. Lay the wrap flat on a clean surface.
2. Sprinkle the feta cheese evenly over the center of the wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
3. Arrange the olives on top of the feta.
4. Sprinkle the chopped walnuts over the olives.
5. Add a sprinkle of salt and pepper to taste.
7. Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a neat cylinder.
8. Slice the wrap in half, if desired.
